text:
jules: Thinking out loud 7 status-envelope proposal to unify client-facing error payloads across routing/quotas/rollouts. Could make SDKs and console consistent.
anita: Love the idea. What's in a status-envelope?
jules: Minimal sketch:
```
{
  status_code: "ENVELOPE_CODE",  # coarse client enum (ok|soft_degrade|quota_limit|hard_fail)
  http_status: 502,               # canonical HTTP code
  hint: "reduce_batch",          # optional action hint for UI
  meta: { reason: "quota_exhausted", route: "eu-west-1" },
  internal_id: null,              # redacted for clients
}
```
rahul: Important to separate `status_code` from `http_status` so we can keep HTTP semantics while giving richer signals.
emma: For console we can map `status_code` -> badge color + copy. e.g. soft_degrade -> yellow & "Degraded - fallback model". hard_fail -> red & "Service unavailable".
jules: For quotas, propose extra headers: `X-Quota-Remaining`, `X-Quota-Reset-Seconds`, and `X-Status-Envelope: true` to indicate envelope present.
anita: Can we avoid leaking numeric quotas to end users? maybe X-Quota-Remaining should be optional per-tenant preference. Some orgs don't want to expose exact remaining.
rahul: Add an opt-out global flag `tenant.expose_quota_numbers=false`. If false, server returns `X-Quota-State: exhausted|low|ok`.
emma: SDKs need client_exposed_code -> recommended action mapping. Draft proposal mapping in thread: 
```
ENVELOPE_CODE:soft_degrade -> use_result_but_no_retry
ENVELOPE_CODE:quota_limit -> fail_with_quota_hint
ENVELOPE_CODE:hard_fail -> retry_with_backoff
ENVELOPE_CODE:ok -> normal
```
jules: Wait, retry_with_backoff for hard_fail? Shouldn't hard_fail be non-retryable if it's a deployment? We need sub-reasons: transient vs terminal. Add `subcode` like `transient_runtime` or `deployment_locked`.
anita: Good call. subcode allows SDK to pick retry policy. Also log `server_duration_ms` and `route_version` in telemetry.
ci-bot: CI alert: integration tests for status-envelope missing for websocket and gRPC clients.
rahul: websocket/gRPC: envelopes should be mapped to a top-level field or status frame. For streaming, send an initial envelope frame then stream tokens. If envelope indicates hard_fail, stop stream with final status.
emma: Console UX: show aggregated "Envelope events" with top subcodes and example tenants affected. Link to runbook. Collapsing rules: collapse repeated identical envelope events within 1m per-route.
jules: Rollout implication: when toggling model variants, we should emit an envelope event marking old->new transition to avoid confusion. Also, keep a `bridge_window_seconds` during which envelope subcode `soft_degrade` may be expected.
anita: Add test: simulate model swap and assert SDK observable state transitions: ok -> soft_degrade -> ok within 60s.
rahul: Security note: never include internal IDs in envelope for public requests. Keep `trace_id` but mark as admin-only.
jemma_typo: (typo)
emma: lol.
jules: Can we include a human-friendly message copy `user_message` for console/tooling and a separate `debug_message` for admin logs? Both must be localizable.
anita: Localization is important. `user_message` should be a key referencing i18n table rather than free text. Eg: `user_message_key: "quota.depleted.contact_support"`
rahul: Telemetry: emit `envelope_event` with fields: status_code, subcode, route, tenant_id_hash, model_variant, latency_ms, is_canary. Keep tenant hashed to respect PII.
ci-bot: perf test scheduled for envelope parsing in SDKs at 2024-08-01T04:00Z.
emma: Docs TODO: console examples, SDK examples (python/js), HTTP header spec, gRPC mapping.
jules: Next steps: 1) RFC draft with schema + mappings 2) API changes: X-Status-Envelope header + opt-outs 3) Console badge + aggregation 4) SDK ergonomic helpers 5) rollout plan (hosted default on, dedicated opt-in)
anita: Adding that we should ship with a conservative default: envelope present but minimal fields for first canary.
rahul: I'll write the schema draft and include exhaustive subcodes.
emma: I'll mock the badge flows and the collapsed timeline.
jules: tagging @anita @rahul @emma - I'll open RFC and link back. Thanks all :rocket:
infra-bot: feature-toggle created: status-envelope-v1 (canary 10%) at 2024-07-20T09:00Z
jules: one final note: ensure we agree on failure semantics for retries in SDKs and document in runbook. Closing thread, RFC soon.
